label: Prompt workshop
summary: A prompt workshop, in Maaike's work, is a structured interactive session where participants collectively experiment with prompting an AI image generator. The specific instance documented here focuses on de-biasing Dall-e by using conscious and meticulous prompting to surface and study bias. It is framed as both a learning exercise and a practical attempt to produce more representative image outputs.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike uses the prompt workshop format as a hands-on extension of her ongoing research into stereotypes in Dall-e. Rather than just writing about bias, she invites her audience to participate directly, treating the prompting process as a way to examine bias in the model and in the participants themselves. The workshop sits downstream of earlier posts on Dall-e stereotypes and is positioned as a next step: moving from observation to active, community-based intervention.
open_questions: Whether conscious prompting can meaningfully reduce bias in outputs or only reveal it more clearly.
What it means for an image to represent 'the real us', and who gets to define that.
